sourceSentences: Phase Dive resets Ekko's basic attack timer. Ekko can cast any of his abilities during the dash.
The dash distance can be extended to up-to 550 units when targeting across terrain. It will only extend for the distance needed to cross the wall.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away during the empowered attack's cast time, it is cancelled but not consumed.
Triggering Resonance against a champion grants Ekko bonus movement speed
Resonance cannot affect the same target more than once every few seconds.
Afterwards, the grenade contracts and homes back to Ekko at an increased speed, dealing magic damage to enemies hit.
Enemies can be hit only once per pass.
Enemies can see the indicator for Parallel Convergence 2 seconds after casting.
If Ekko enters the sphere before it expires, it detonates to grant him a shield for 2 seconds and stun enemies within for 2.25 seconds.
Ekko can detonate the expansion even while untargetable (i.e. Chronobreak dash), but not if he is resurrecting.
Upon activation, Ekko travels full distance through the link, and thus will detonate Parallel Convergence that the link passes through.
Upon learning Chronobreak or if its current cooldown is lower than 4 seconds, Ekko reveals a time-delayed afterimage of himself that constantly tracks where he was 4 seconds ago.
Broken passive will give you movement speed which will allow you to disengage from a fight.
After proing passive, you won't be able to pro it again on the same target for a couple of seconds.
Could proing passive on multiple enemies refresh my movement speed? The answer is yes.
did you know that your W will be invisible for a brief amount of time before the enemy could see it?
Keep an eye on the second part of your queue and try to hit it because it's really big deal.
The easiest echo combo will be dashing in using E then Q auto attack and back off with movement speed.
You have to press E and Q at the same time for that to work.
If you hit them with Q, they're slowed by more than 40%, which means that you're going to close the gap and finally get in range to E and finish off the combo.
If you time your E right, you can jump right on top of people when they blink or dash to a certain location.
Ew is a very powerful combo since it cancels your W animation and give the enemy very few options. This combo will guarantee a shield and probably even a stun.
Cast your E over the wall, while dropping your W on top of the Krugs, and then use the second E instance to auto-attack the big Krug to blink over the wall.
I'm talking about following enemy flashes or movement abilities with Ekko's second E.
The second trick involves using the EQ combo to slow enemies inside your W.
By stacking the slow from your Q with the slow from your W, you can close the distance and secure stuns on targets that might otherwise escape.
The trick? Don't skill your ultimate at level 6. This allows you to hide your clone
